name: PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk
summary: PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk, together with its subsidiary, PT Komala Indonesia, provides helicopter charter services in Indonesia. The company offers single- and twin-engine helicopters, and procurement services. It also provides non-scheduled commercial air transportation, air transportation leasing, and other air transportation services. The company's services are used for VIP transport, aerial surveys, fire water bombing, geomagnetic surveys, external cargo transport, and medical evacuation applications. PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia.
